DefensibilityClass.description:
Spec §5.6: `fact | utterance | non_factual`.

*fact*        — the unit asserts something the matrix permits as fact.
*utterance*   — someone said it; the system stands by the saying, not
                the substance.
*non_factual* — opinion / interpretation / rhetorical content.
DefensibilityClass.title: DefensibilityClass

DefensibilityFloor.description:
Author-set floor below which Solva refuses to compose an answer.

Spec §8.1 + UX ("set a defensibility floor"). Solva will not
surface a unit in the answer whose `defensibility` ring fails this
floor.

minimum_class.description: Lowest acceptable defensibility class. Default: utterance.

minimum_scores.description: Per-dimension lower bounds. Units below any dim are excluded.

DefensibilityFloor.title: DefensibilityFloor

EstateRegionSelector.title: EstateRegionSelector

ObjectiveMode.description:
Spec §8.1: per-run or portfolio.

* per_run   — one-shot objective, narrow scope, returns answer + trace.
* portfolio — long-running standing objective, re-runs as the
              Normalized Tier evolves.
ObjectiveMode.title: ObjectiveMode

ScoreVector.description:
Spec §5.6: five-dimensional defensibility score.

Each dimension is `float` in [0, 1]. The Solva depth governor (G1)
writes these; at G0 they are populated by the synthetic fixture or
left at 0.0 default.
ScoreVector.title: ScoreVector

provenance_required.description: If true, every cited unit must carry a non-empty Provenance ring.
provenance_required.title: Provenance Required

tags.description: Optional author tags; surfaced in the Operator Console (G5).
tags.title: Tags
